title: OpenAI GPT-Realtime-2 voice model and Realtime API expansion
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-Realtime-2, a voice model built on GPT-5-class reasoning, alongside GPT-Realtime-Translate and GPT-Realtime-Whisper. The release expands real-time voice agents with continuous-stream audio handling and a 128K context window.

web_findings.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Realtime-2
web_findings.snippet: Three new voice models announced 7 May 2026; Realtime API exits beta.

web_findings.title: gpt-realtime-2 Model | OpenAI API
web_findings.snippet: 128K context, $32/$64 per million audio input/output tokens.
